fichas.title: Deep foundations and piles
fichas.summary: Deep foundations are used where load-bearing strata lie too deep for shallow foundations. Reinforced-concrete piles transfer building loads through weak ground to load-bearing strata. Pile design depends on ground loading and subsoil conditions, established through investigation boreholes and probing. The page describes pile load-transfer mechanisms, classifications by location, installation, loading, production and installation, and illustrates retaining-wall types, boring depths, pile principles, and a pressed-concrete bored-pile system.
